Isolated spermatogenic failure with globozoospermia; reproductive dysfunction without demonstrated endocrine disease.

Hypertrophy and fibrosis of nasal skin and sebaceous glands; airway disease is not established.

Congenital cerebral clefts cause neurologic dysfunction; persistent strabismus affects ocular alignment in 80-99%.
Benign tumor occupying the adrenal endocrine gland; hormonal activity is not required for this site label.
Inherited isolated nail dysplasia and dystrophy; extra-axis immune or hematologic findings are very rare.

Defined by cutaneous lesions or eruptions on the leg.
Inherited platelet production and granule-function disorder; mucocutaneous bleeding does not establish independent skin or mucosal disease.
Retinal degeneration with posterior staphyloma; isolated short stature and obesity do not establish additional organ damage.

Immune vasculitis with respiratory granulomatosis; renal injury ~70-85%. Ear, neurologic, ocular, endocrine and joint findings omitted under the four-axis cap.
Primary CNS germ-cell tumor involving the pineal body, an endocrine gland.
Inherited skin blistering and scarring; oral/esophageal mucosal injury occurs in roughly 30% or more overall, varying substantially by subtype.
Chronic immune-mediated airway inflammation with nocturnal airflow obstruction and reduced pulmonary function.
Inherited myopia is an ocular growth and refractive disorder.
Persistent dysfunction or misalignment of neural circadian sleep-wake regulation.
Collagen-related bone fragility; dentinogenesis imperfecta ~30-50% and hearing loss ~40-50% by adulthood. Blue sclera alone does not impair vision.
